name: Dr. Shamim Boksha
designation: Consultant (Medicine, Gastroenterology & Liver disease)
bio: Dr. Shamim Boksha is a highly regarded specialist in gastroenterology, offering exceptional care and expertise in Chittagong. As a gastroenterologist, his scope of practice extends beyond the gastrointestinal tract, encompassing other crucial organs involved in digestion, such as the gallbladder, pancreas, and liver. With years of experience, Dr. Boksha has earned a reputation as the best in his field, particularly when it comes to managing chronic hepatitis infections. One of the essential services provided by Dr. Boksha is colonoscopy, a crucial procedure for detecting polyps, cancer, or other diseases in the colon and rectum. He emphasizes the importance of screening colonoscopy for individuals without risk factors, which is recommended to begin at age 50. However, Dr. Boksha remains vigilant and advises early screening for those with increased risk factors, such as a family history of colon cancer, genetic conditions, or inflammatory bowel diseases. Under Dr. Shamim Boksha's care, patients can be assured of full attention, meticulous diagnosis, and comprehensive treatment, making him the go-to expert for gastrointestinal and digestive health concerns.
